parameters.name: total_leasable_area
parameters.description: Total leasable area of the mall

parameters.name: rent_share
parameters.description: Fixed fraction of each shop's expected annual profit paid as rent

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Single planning period over the planning horizon

parameters.name: area_per_shop
parameters.description: Area occupied by one shop of each store type

parameters.name: min_shops
parameters.description: Minimum allowable number of shops for each store type

parameters.name: max_shops
parameters.description: Maximum allowable number of shops for each store type

parameters.name: feasible_count_levels
parameters.description: Feasible count levels provided for each store type

parameters.name: expected_profit_per_shop
parameters.description: Expected annual profit per shop for each store type and feasible count level

variables.name: store_counts
variables.description: Integer number of shops of each store type to lease

variables.name: total_rental_income
variables.description: Total rental income for the mall

auxiliary_variables.name: income_contribution
auxiliary_variables.description: Rental income contribution from each store type

auxiliary_variables.name: count_selection
auxiliary_variables.description: Binary indicator for selecting a feasible count level for each store type

constraints.name: store_count_integrality
constraints.description: Each store type count must be an integer number of shops

constraints.name: store_count_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Each store type count must be nonnegative

constraints.name: store_count_lower_bound
constraints.description: Each store type count must be at least the minimum allowable count for that type

constraints.name: store_count_upper_bound
constraints.description: Each store type count must be at most the maximum allowable count for that type

constraints.name: area_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total occupied area across all store types must not exceed the mall's total leasable area

constraints.name: profit_data_domain
constraints.description: Each store type count must be selected only from the feasible count levels for which profit data are provided

constraints.name: rental_income_definition
constraints.description: Total rental income is computed from the selected counts using the fixed rent share and the count-dependent per-shop profit values

constraints.name: income_linking
constraints.description: Link total rental income to per-type income contributions

constraints.name: count_selection
constraints.description: Select exactly one feasible count level for each store type using binary indicators over the feasible count set

constraints.name: count_definition
constraints.description: Define the chosen store count as the selected feasible count level for each store type

constraints.name: income_definition
constraints.description: Define each store type's rental income as the rent share times the chosen per-shop profit times the selected count

objectives.name: total_rental_income_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize the mall's total rental income

objectives.name: feasible_store_mix
objectives.description: Find a feasible store mix satisfying all stated leasing and capacity constraints if no feasible solution exists for the maximizing objective

final_objective.description: Maximize total rental income from all store types. The income is represented directly by the scalar variable Z, which is linked linearly to per-type income contributions.
